findings.text: `_notify` snapshots the subscriber list under `self._lock` but writes to each pipe outside it, so a stream whose `close()` runs in that window has already closed both descriptors — a closed fd raises and is suppressed, but a descriptor number reused by another pipe in the meantime silently receives the byte and reports a spurious change.

the done_when requires the `/_index` and `/_discover` handlers each to stamp their tree's read, and only reckon/serve.py:3625 (`/_index`) is exercised; no case in tests/test_cross_node_writes_refresh_the_index.py issues a `/_discover` request, so this arm is unguarded.

`assert serve._head_identity(repo) == head_before` takes both sides from the same call on the same path, so it holds whether or not the git-index write is seen; the clause it is meant to serve is carried by the `assert ran == []` assertion that follows it.
